description: A production-history and visual-craft essay on building SG-1’s galaxy through Vancouver locations, the physical gate, standing sets, art departments, guest performers and effects.

related_resources.reason: Primary interviews about the transition from movie gate to weekly television set and the effects pipeline.
Direct art department testimony about moving standing sets, build space, reused environments and crew labor.
Firsthand production-design recollections and gate construction.
Location manager testimony about geographic range and filming logistics.
Physical water-tank imagery and television visual effects.
Secondary corroboration of Burnaby studios and Simon Fraser University location use.
